name: VIBE Benchmark
description: Comprehensive full-stack development benchmark spanning Web, Simulation, Android, iOS, and Backend tasks. Features an Agent-as-Verifier paradigm where tasks require multi-platform implementation with automated verification.
creator: MiniMax
notes: No model consistently passes all tests. Agent-as-Verifier paradigm where agents must generate code that passes automatically-generated tests across Web, Simulation, Android, iOS, and Backend domains.
